issue_context.title: NuxtClientFallback hydration broken in webpack build
issue_context.body:
### Environment

------------------------------
- Operating System: Windows_NT
- Node Version:     v18.15.0
- Nuxt Version:     3.4.1
- Nitro Version:    2.3.3
- Package Manager:  pnpm@8.1.1
- Builder:          vite
- User Config:      -
- Runtime Modules:  -
- Build Modules:    -
------------------------------

### Reproduction

- run `npx cross-env TEST_BUILDER=webpack pnpm nuxi build .\test\fixtures\basic\` on nuxt repo
- run it there will be a hydration issue. VNode will not be mounted correctly

### Describe the bug

A silent bug (no warning or error in the console). When using wbpack as a builder, `NuxtClientFallback` has a strange behavior, mounting its DOM node without discarding the old nodes

### Additional context

found with https://github.com/nuxt/nuxt/pull/20336

### Logs

_No response_

review_comments: it seems likely we need to update the `isVue` helper util to correctly identify template Vue imports within webpack, so we can preserve the performance improvement of restricting this transform to just vue templates.
actually, I think your solution is right here, as we're directly replacing text in the SFC...

i just begin to understand how it work,
